title: Failure to detect gas release
goal: Show detector, logic-solver, and maintenance-inhibit paths that can prevent a gas alarm.

rubric.must: The top event visibly joins a gas-release demand with a detection-function failure at an AND gate.
Both detector-channel failures visibly combine at an AND gate.
Logic-solver failure and an inhibit-conditioned alarm path are visible as alternatives in the detection-failure branch.
The maintenance-inhibit condition is visibly attached to an inhibit gate.
The release, detector, solver, and alarm-path basic events visibly show probabilities.
The major detection paths are visually separated and readable from top event to basic events.
